name: India Legal & Courts
description: For litigators, in-house counsel and legal journalists who need same day awareness of judgments, listings and regulatory circulars. Combines the legal trade press with primary regulator feeds.

themes.label: Supreme Court
themes.hint: Proceedings before the Supreme Court of India: judgments, interim orders, constitution bench hearings, oral remarks, collegium recommendations and cause list events. The forum is the deciding fact, whatever the subject matter.

themes.label: High Courts & Tribunals
themes.hint: Rulings and hearings in a High Court, NCLT, NCLAT, SAT, NGT, CAT or a consumer or arbitration forum. Name the bench where possible. Trial court and magistrate matters also belong here.

themes.label: Regulatory & Compliance
themes.hint: Binding instruments from the executive side: SEBI and RBI circulars, MCA notifications, gazette publications, rules framed under a statute, filing deadlines and compliance calendars. No court is involved.

themes.label: Legislation & Reform
themes.hint: Bills, ordinances, draft rules out for comment, law commission and committee reports, and debate over amending a statute. The law is being made or proposed rather than applied.

themes.label: Legal Profession
themes.hint: The bar and bench as an institution: judicial appointments, transfers and recusals, Bar Council actions, law firm partner moves and mandates, legal education, contempt and disciplinary proceedings against lawyers.

themes.label: Investigation & Enforcement
themes.hint: Action by ED, CBI, SFIO, income tax or the police: chargesheets, arrests, attachments, bail and remand, extradition, and prosecution of economic offences. The story is an investigation rather than an adjudication.
